title: The Burning Wolf Revisited
author: Marguerite Joubert
blurb: Wren Vane, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
